user.title: E-REDES Account

data_description.access_token: The value of the 'aat' cookie from your browser. The full Cookie header is also accepted.
data_description.cpe: Your electricity meter CPE code (e.g., PT0002000012345678XX)

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with E-REDES

init.title: E-REDES Options
init.description: Configure E-REDES history synchronization and the local current-day Energy Dashboard estimate.

data_description.history_sync_frequency: Synchronize hourly or after a configurable number of days.
data_description.history_sync_time: For day-based schedules, the exact local Home Assistant time. For hourly schedules, the minute and second are used for every hour.
data_description.history_sync_interval_days: Number of days between successful synchronizations when using the day-based frequency.
data_description.provisional_refresh_interval_minutes: Minutes between local refreshes of today's provisional grid-energy estimate from configured Energy Dashboard devices. This continues even when E-REDES authentication is unavailable.
